style: Style: an original illustration in the manner of a Siamese manuscript painting (samut khoi folding book) and Ayutthaya-era temple mural line art: fine black ink contour lines, flat areas of a few natural pigments only (red ochre, indigo, muted green, touches of gold leaf, chalk white), on warm aged khoi-paper texture with soft stains. Head-and-shoulders bust, three-quarter view, centred, facing slightly left, dignified and respectful. Plain aged-paper background fading to the edges, no scenery. Any sword is a Siamese or Burmese daab: straight wrapped hilt, small round pommel, no Japanese-style guard. Historically plausible late-16th-century dress of mainland Southeast Asia. Not photorealistic, not anime, not a game character. No text, no letters, no seals, no signature, no border.

items.naresuan_prince: Prince Naresuan of Ayutthaya at about 25, viceroy (uparat) of Phitsanulok in the 1580s: lean, alert, determined young face, keen eyes, short-cropped Siamese hair, clean-shaven; wearing a fitted long-sleeved Siamese princely military jacket in deep red with a gold-trimmed collar over a dark sash, a small gold pointed princely headpiece; resolute, depicted with great respect, as in a royal temple mural.
items.naresuan_king: King Naresuan of Ayutthaya at about 37, a great warrior king: strong, composed, resolute face, steady eyes, thin moustache; wearing a tall pointed Siamese royal crown of gold (chada style) and a gold-brocade royal jacket with ornate shoulder pieces; serene authority, depicted with great respect, as in a royal temple mural.
items.ekathotsarot: Prince Ekathotsarot of Ayutthaya, younger brother of King Naresuan, at about 33: calm, broad, kind but firm face, short-cropped hair, light moustache; wearing a fitted indigo Siamese princely jacket with gold trim and a red sash and a small gold pointed princely headpiece; depicted with great respect, as in a royal temple mural.
items.maha_thammaracha: King Maha Thammaracha of Ayutthaya in his fifties, father of Naresuan: dignified, thoughtful, slightly weary face, grey short-cropped hair; wearing a Siamese royal crown of gold (chada style) and a dark green royal jacket with gold brocade; depicted with great respect, as in a royal temple mural.
items.bayinnaung: King Bayinnaung of the Burmese Toungoo dynasty in his fifties, a mighty conqueror: strong, proud, commanding face, moustache; wearing a tall tiered Burmese royal crown of gold with flared side wings and an ornate red-and-gold Burmese court robe with a high stiff collar; grand and severe.
items.nanda_bayin: King Nanda Bayin of the Burmese Toungoo dynasty in his fifties: heavy, stern, troubled face, moustache; wearing a tiered Burmese royal crown of gold and an ornate dark crimson Burmese royal robe with gold embroidery and a high collar.
items.mingyi_swa: Mingyi Swa, crown prince (Maha Uparaja) of the Burmese Toungoo kingdom, in his late twenties: proud, brave, intense young face, light moustache; wearing a pointed Burmese princely headdress of gold and a white-and-gold Burmese court jacket with a high collar; depicted respectfully as a worthy opponent.
items.khanchong: Phra Maha Thera Khanchong, a senior Mon Buddhist monk of the 1580s, in his sixties: shaven head, wise calm aged face, gentle eyes; wearing a dark ochre monk robe draped over one shoulder; serene, depicted respectfully. Hands folded holding a palm-leaf fan; absolutely no sword, no weapon, no blade of any kind.
